capabilities: Index scripture references across vault notes, treating variants, ranges, chains and filenames as the same passage
Show matching notes in a side pane with clickable results, hover previews and insert-link actions
Record intertext relationships and open #intertext questions between passages
Insert chapter coverage maps and open passages in Logos, Bible Gateway, Blue Letter Bible or STEP Bible
Download translations for verse pop-ups or write a whole Bible into the vault as linked notes
extras: Desktop only. Reads notes locally; downloads translations from bible.helloao.org on request, with no telemetry or accounts. Warns Omnisearch users to enable respect for excluded files when Bibles are added to the vault.
problem: Obsidian's search treats scripture references as plain text, so finding notes on a passage means remembering every notation variant and searching manually.

relations.evidence: If you add a Bible to your vault and use Omnisearch, turn on Omnisearch's option to respect Obsidian's excluded files.
Open in Logos (and Bible Gateway, Blue Letter Bible or STEP Bible, if you turn them on in the Open in tab).
The small arrow beside the reference in the pop-up opens the passage in Logos, Bible Gateway, Blue Letter Bible or STEP Bible.

requires.name: Logos (optional; also Bible Gateway, Blue Letter Bible, STEP Bible)

summary: Side pane that indexes Bible passage references across the vault and lists every note touching the passages in the current note.
